name: Stripe
mood: Cool-white global commerce ledger with deep navy type, weight-300 sohne-var typography, precision 4px geometry, hairline dividers, dense product modules, and one indigo action color.

deepNavy.role: Primary text, dark panels, footer anchors, and code headings.

slateLedger.role: Body copy, navigation labels, and secondary headings.

blueGray.role: Muted body copy, metadata, captions, and helper labels.

borderMist.role: Hairline dividers, card borders, and section rules.

gridLine.role: Charts, table rules, and subtle grid structure.

cloudLedger.role: Page background and pale section canvas.

paperWhite.role: Card, panel, terminal, and nav surfaces.

indigoAction.role: Primary CTA, active links, arrows, and selected states.

cyanAccent.role: Small chart accents and data sparks only.

greenLedger.role: Positive status, growth indicators, and accepted payments.

amberNotice.role: Warnings, small badges, and narrow status strips.

fallbacks.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

rules: Use sohne-var-style type for the full interface.
Keep body text at weight 300 to 400.
Use weight 500 for buttons and nav actions.
Do not introduce serif or expressive display fonts.

shadows.none: Use dividers, borders, grids, and contrast instead of box-shadow.

components.name: Indigo Primary Button
components.recipe: Indigo Action fill, Paper White text, 4px radius, 8px 16px padding, sohne-var 15px/500, optional right arrow.

components.name: Navy Secondary Button
components.recipe: Deep Navy fill, Paper White text, 4px radius, same size as primary.

components.name: Ghost Text Link
components.recipe: Transparent, Deep Navy or Indigo text, no border, 15px/500, small arrow icon.

components.name: Top Navigation
components.recipe: Paper White or transparent nav over Cloud Ledger, logo left, compact center links, paired right CTAs.

components.name: Hero Ledger Block
components.recipe: Two-column hero with display heading, short body copy, paired CTA buttons, and right-side product mockup.

components.name: Product Mockup Card
components.recipe: Paper White surface, 4px radius, 1px Border Mist border, no shadow, dense internal chart/table/code content.

components.name: Data Table
components.recipe: Paper White or transparent rows, 1px Border Mist dividers, 13px to 14px text, Blue Gray metadata, Deep Navy values.

components.name: Code Panel
components.recipe: Deep Navy or Paper White panel, 4px radius, muted line numbers, indigo/cyan syntax accents.

components.name: Metric Tile
components.recipe: Paper White, 4px radius, 1px Border Mist border, 13px caption, 31px value, optional Green Ledger delta.

components.name: Globe Or Map Panel
components.recipe: Cool blue-gray map/grid visualization with hairline grid and tiny Indigo or Cyan nodes.

components.name: Payment Method Strip
components.recipe: Horizontal icon row, Paper White background, Border Mist separators, Deep Navy labels, muted captions.

components.name: Footer Infrastructure Grid
components.recipe: Deep Navy footer or Cloud Ledger sitemap with tight link columns and muted links.

do: Use sohne-var at weight 300 for large headings and most body text.
Use Indigo Action for the main CTA and active states.
Keep 4px radius on cards, buttons, inputs, and code panels.
Use hairline dividers and table rules to create structure.
Use Deep Navy for text and dark infrastructure panels.
Use Cloud Ledger as the main cool-white page background.
Keep data and product modules dense but aligned.
Use small arrows on links and action buttons.
dont: Do not use a multicolor marketing palette.
Do not make indigo a full-page background.
Do not use rounded SaaS cards above 4px.
Do not use expressive serif or display fonts.
Do not use stock photography as primary imagery.
Do not make body text heavier than 400.
Do not add decorative gradients behind sections.
